source.title: Larne Times, 31 January 1931, p. 3 ("Larne Urban Council. Election of Chairmen")
source.publisher: Larne Times (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: At the statutory meeting on 23 January 1931 the clerk, as returning officer, announced 'that there had been no poll in the urban elections' and named the five declared elected ward by ward.

note: Annual election of five urban councillors, one for each ward, January 1931; there was no poll (Larne Times, 31 January 1931, p. 3). Returned unopposed.
